info.title: DialNexa API
info.description: Public `/v1` REST API for the DialNexa voice AI platform.

post.description:
Creates an agent with its first draft version. Optionally include `agent_functions` and `post_call_analysis` in the body to set them at creation time.

**Phone number fields:** `inbound_phone_number_id` and `outbound_phone_number_id` must belong to the authenticated workspace. On create, these IDs are stored on the draft version. Live dispatch routing is claimed when the version is published through `PATCH /v1/agents/{id}` with `is_published: true`.

patch.description:
Updates the specified draft version of an agent. `version_number` is required.

**Managing functions via this endpoint:**
- Pass `agent_functions: [...]` to fully replace all functions for that version.
- Pass `agent_functions: []` to remove all functions.
- Omit `agent_functions` entirely to leave existing functions untouched.

**Post-call analysis LLM:**
- Pass `post_call_analysis_llm_id`, for example `llm_A1B2C3D4E5F6G7`, to set the LLM used for post-call field extraction.
- Pass `null` to clear the override and revert to the organization default.
- Omit the field to leave it unchanged.

**Phone number assignment:**
- `inbound_phone_number_id` and `outbound_phone_number_id` are applied to live routing only when `is_published: true` is included in the same request.
- Sending a phone number ID without `is_published: true` leaves live routing unchanged.
- Pass an empty string to detach a phone number while publishing.
- Outbound changes can return `409 Conflict` when active workflows still use the number. Pause those workflows before retrying.

Published versions cannot be updated, except to set `is_published: true` to publish a draft.

sip_trunk_enabled.description: When true, Speech IO uses SIP trunking (e.g. asterisk) for this number.

voicemail_detection.description: Indicates whether voicemail detection is enabled

hangup_on_voicemail.description: Hang up immediately when voicemail is detected instead of leaving a message

voicemail_message.description: Message spoken when voicemail is detected and hangup_on_voicemail is false. Supports Handlebars template syntax such as {{variable}} and must be valid Handlebars template text.
voicemail_message.example: Hi, please call us back at your convenience.
voicemail_message.default: Please leave a message after the beep.

listen_for_keypad.description: Whether the agent listens for keypad (DTMF) input from the caller

keypad_timeout_sec.description: Seconds to wait for keypad input before timing out (0-15)

termination_key.description: Single character key that ends the call (digits, * or #)

digit_limit.description: Maximum number of DTMF digits to collect from the caller (1-50)

end_call_on_silence_sec.description: Seconds of silence after which the call is automatically ended. Accepted range: 15 to 30 seconds. Must be more than 5 seconds above reminder_message_interval when reminders are configured.

max_call_duration_sec.description: Maximum call duration in seconds before the call is forcibly ended. Accepted range: 60 to 5400 seconds for cascaded agents. Speech to Speech agents are capped at 3600 seconds.

pause_before_speaking_sec.description: Seconds of silence inserted before the agent starts speaking

ring_duration_sec.description: How long to let the phone ring before treating the call as unanswered (seconds)

ambient_noise.description: Enable or disable ambient noise playback on the call

response_eagerness.description: How eagerly the agent responds (0 to 1). Only applied when transcriber is Soniox.

boosted_keywords.description: Comma-separated recognition hints for supported Deepgram and Soniox transcribers. Terms can contain letters, numbers, and spaces only. The normalized list supports up to 100 terms, 50 characters per term, and 2000 total characters.

boost_dynamic_variables.description: When true, sanitized values from test-call or batch-recipient dynamic variables are appended to boosted_keywords for that call. Configured terms keep priority. Applies to supported Deepgram and Soniox primary and fallback transcribers.

transcriber_id.description: ID of the transcriber catalog entry

fallback_stt_enabled.description: Enable parallel fallback STT for this agent

stt_fallback_transcriber_id.description: Fallback STT transcriber catalog entry. Required when fallback_stt_enabled is true and must differ from transcriber_id.

stt_fallback_wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for primary STT after fallback finalizes first

audio_cache_enabled.description: Enable TTS audio caching for this agent

folder_id.description: ID of the folder this agent belongs to

pipeline_type.description: Pipeline subtype for Single_Prompt_Agent. Cascaded = ASR→LLM→TTS pipeline. Speech_To_Speech = direct speech model. Null for Conversational_Flow_Agent.

version_title.description: Version title (optional, will be auto-generated if not provided, max 35 characters)

description.example: This agent handles customer support inquiries

outbound_phone_number_id.description: ID of the outbound phone number to use for this agent. Must be an existing phone number ID in your organization. Stored on the draft at creation; live outbound routing is claimed when the version is published.

inbound_phone_number_id.description: ID of the inbound phone number to use for this agent. Must be an existing phone number ID in your organization. Stored on the draft at creation; live inbound routing is claimed when the version is published.

llm_id.description: ID of the LLM associated with the agent

language_id.description: ID of the language the agent speaks

voice_id.description: ID of the voice used by the agent

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook associated with the agent

prompt_text.description: Main instructions for the agent. Supports Handlebars template syntax such as {{variable}} for dynamic content. Must be valid Handlebars template text.
prompt_text.example: Hello, how can I assist you today?

system_prompt_text.description: Static system instructions for the agent. Use prompt_text for dynamic content via {{variable}} syntax.
system_prompt_text.example: You are a helpful customer support agent named Sarah.

node_positions.description: Node positions for Conversational_Flow_Agent type (stored as JSON string)

welcome_message.description: Opening message spoken by the agent at the start of the call. Supports Handlebars template syntax such as {{variable}} and must be valid Handlebars template text.

knowledge_base_ids.description: IDs of the knowledge bases attached to this agent version

kb_max_chunks.description: Maximum number of RAG chunks to fetch (1-10)

kb_min_score.description: Minimum similarity score threshold for RAG results (0-1)

default_dynamic_variables.description: Default values for dynamic variables used in Handlebars templates. For call-transfer flows, agent_transfer_destinations accepts up to 7 pipe-separated phone numbers. Each number must use US +1 or India +91 and exactly 10 digits after the country code.

voice_model_id.description: Speech synthesis model for the selected voice. The model must belong to the same provider as voice_id. Omit this field when you want DialNexa to apply the recommended model. For ElevenLabs voices, use eleven_flash_v2_5 where supported. To find supported models for one voice, call GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}/voice-models.

voice_pitch.description: Pitch adjustment of the voice (-1 to 1)

opt_out_sensitive_data_storage.description: Opt out of sensitive data storage

fallback_llm_enabled.description: Enable fallback LLM for this agent

predictive_preprocessing_enabled.description: Enable predictive preprocessing for this agent version

llm_fallback_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait before triggering the fallback LLM

llm_fallback_model.description: ID (llms.id) of the LLM to use as fallback

fallback_voices.description: Fallback voices for TTS. Used when the primary voice is unavailable.

agent_functions.description: Functions the agent can invoke during a call (e.g. end call, transfer, booking). Passed at create time; use PATCH to replace later.

description.example: Books a calendar appointment for the caller

post_call_analysis.description: Fields to extract from the call transcript after the call ends.

agent_background.description: Agent background (required for Conversational_Flow_Agent type on update)
agent_background.example: You have 5 years of experience in customer support and specialize in helping customers with technical issues.

prompt_caching_enabled.description: Enable OpenAI Prompt Caching for this agent version. DialNexa must enable this feature for your workspace.

phone_number.description: Phone number to call (must include country code). Format: +[country code][phone number]

agent_id.description: Agent ID to use for the call. Must belong to the authenticated organization.

agent_version_number.description: Specific agent version number to use (optional). If provided, must be a published version. If not provided, will use the latest published version.

metadata.description: Metadata for the call including customer information and any additional context. This data will be available during the call for personalization.

notes.description: Optional notes stored on the call log. Must be a JSON object with at most 15 top-level keys.

id.description: Unique call ID for tracking. Use this ID to reference the call in other API endpoints.

to_phone_number.description: The phone number that will receive the call.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent used for this call.

agent_version_number.description: The version number of the agent used for this call.

name.description: Name of the knowledge base (must be unique within the workspace)

url.description: The URL to which webhook events will be sent.

events.description: List of events this webhook is subscribed to.

secret.description: Secret used to sign webhook payloads.

terminationUri.description: SIP termination host[:port]; must not use a sip: URI prefix

authMode.description: How the SIP provider authorizes the trunk. userpass requires sipTrunkUserName and sipTrunkPassword. ip requires both credentials to be omitted and the provider to allowlist the DialNexa signaling IP.

sipTrunkUserName.description: SIP authentication username. Required for authMode=userpass and forbidden for authMode=ip.

sipTrunkPassword.description: SIP authentication password stored encrypted. Required for authMode=userpass and forbidden for authMode=ip.

type.description: The type of phone number (local, tollfree, etc.)

monthly_rental_rate.description: The monthly rental rate for the phone number

setup_rate.description: The setup fee for the phone number
